scope: Stu blind one-net/two-net BEN200 measurements, round4 training-data preparation and test-only USBC harvest.
disposition: Max06:22 makes Stu's BEN gate blind on the same1024deals and stops its non-blind blocks; only Stu loop configs/jobs/runs change. round4_arena.sh prepares training from arena Gen8/Gen9 feeds, not a collector transition or local training authorization. Max06:55's USBC records are explicitly TEST ONLY, NEVER TRAINED ON: do not harvest/import them into this immutable corpus or train on them. No local blind mode, new net, BEN job/gate, self-play, training, model promotion or test-data addition.
